description: This header file provides C++11 implementations and replacements for standard utility components such as integer_sequence, index_sequence, apply, exchange, move, forward, and related tag types, designed to be drop-in replacements for C++14 and C++17 features.

classes.name: integer_sequence
classes.description: Template representing a compile-time sequence of integers.

classes.name: index_sequence
classes.description: Alias for integer_sequence<size_t, ...>, used for index sequences.

classes.name: InPlaceTypeTag
classes.description: Tag type for in-place type construction.

classes.name: InPlaceIndexTag
classes.description: Tag type for in-place index construction.

methods.name: make_integer_sequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence of integers from 0 to N-1 of type T.

methods.name: make_index_sequence
methods.description: Creates an index sequence from 0 to N-1.

methods.name: index_sequence_for
methods.description: Creates an index sequence for a parameter pack.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Invokes a callable with arguments unpacked from a tuple.

methods.name: exchange
methods.description: Replaces an object with a new value and returns the old value.

methods.name: make_from_tuple
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T from a tuple of arguments.
